morphology_documented.habit: Low or high climbing woody vine with tendrils
morphology_documented.leaves: Simple glabrous cordate- to triangular-ovate blades up to 15 × 15 cm, sharply/coarsely toothed, occasionally shallowly lobed
morphology_documented.flowers: Small flowers in dichotomously branched inflorescences (genus key)
morphology_documented.fruit: Berry; source notes fruit mistaken for grape
